definitions.name: SQLiteSimulationJobRepository._final_publication_mode
definitions.source:
def _final_publication_mode(self, view: LockedLeaseView) -> str:
        """Classify only the genuine private finalizer session after ingress checks."""
        issued = _view_record(view)
        session = issued.session
        if (_current_session(self) is not session or session.repository is not self
                or session.worker.repository is not self
                or session.worker._operational_lease_session is not session
                or view.purpose != "finalize_operational_publication"):
            raise OperationalLeaseError("final publication requires the exact current private session")
        session._check_ingress(view.purpose)
        mode = session._mode
        if mode not in {"LOCAL_TEMPORAL_PUBLICATION_V1", "OPERATIONAL_LEASE_FOUNDATION_V1"}:
            raise OperationalLeaseError("unknown final publication authority mode")
        return mode

definitions.name: SQLiteSimulationJobRepository._final_publication_sources
definitions.source:
def _final_publication_sources(self, view: LockedLeaseView, paths: dict[str, str], frozen) -> dict[str, Any]:
        from cloud_edge_robot_arm.vision.operational_windows import _OWNERS, _LOCAL_RUNTIMES
        from cloud_edge_robot_arm.repositories.event_autonomy import SQLiteEventAutonomyRepository, InMemoryEventAutonomyRepository

        if sys._getframe(1).f_code is not _WRITER_FUNCTIONS["finalize_operational_publication"].__code__:
            raise OperationalLeaseError("actual finalizer alone binds publication sources")
        if self._final_publication_mode(view) != "LOCAL_TEMPORAL_PUBLICATION_V1":
            raise OperationalLeaseError("local final source audit requires local mode")
        session = _view_record(view).session
        worker = session.worker
        owner = _OWNERS.get(worker)
        if owner is None or owner._startup.repository is not self:
            raise OperationalLeaseError("final publication lacks original app owner")
        owner._check_app_live()
        root = Path(worker.artifact_root).resolve()
        if self._artifact_root is not None and self._artifact_root != root:
            raise OperationalLeaseError("worker artifact root differs from configured repository root")
        self._artifact_root = root  # Bound only inside this genuine private finalizer.
        events = worker.visual_event_repository
        runtime = _LOCAL_RUNTIMES.get(owner)
        if (runtime is None or runtime.source.event_repository is not events
                or runtime.source.job_repository is not self
                or type(events) not in {SQLiteEventAutonomyRepository, InMemoryEventAutonomyRepository}):
            raise OperationalLeaseError("final publication requires the original concrete event repository")
        lock = events._write_lock if type(events) is SQLiteEventAutonomyRepository else events._lock
        with lock:
            owner._check_local_locked(view, purpose=view.purpose, operation_sha256=view.operation_sha256)
            receipts = [dict(row) for row in view._connection.execute(
                "SELECT * FROM simulation_local_publications_v1 WHERE job_id=? ORDER BY operation_id", (session.job_id,))]
            if not receipts:
                raise OperationalLeaseError("final publication has no completed local source receipts")
            for receipt in receipts:
                if (receipt["phase"] != "COMPLETE" or receipt["epoch"] != session.epoch
                        or receipt["attempt"] != view.snapshot["attempt"]):
                    raise OperationalLeaseError("partial or foreign local source receipt cannot confirm terminal publication")
                if type(events) is SQLiteEventAutonomyRepository:
                    row = events._conn.execute("SELECT * FROM visual_local_publications_v1 WHERE operation_id=?",
                                               (receipt["operation_id"],)).fetchone()
                    actual = None if row is None else dict(row)
                else:
                    raw = events._local_publications.get(receipt["operation_id"])
                    actual = None if raw is None else json.loads(raw)
                if actual != receipt:
                    raise OperationalLeaseError("actual job/event completion receipts do not join")
            owner._check_app_live()
        return {
            "artifact_root": str(root), "manifest": self._publication_manifest(root, paths),
            "event_receipts": receipts,
            "event_database": str(events.path.resolve()) if type(events) is SQLiteEventAutonomyRepository else None,
            "event_kind": "sqlite" if type(events) is SQLiteEventAutonomyRepository else "memory",
            "original_time": owner._local_original,
            "original_app_reference": owner.export_record(owner.task_window), "rows": frozen,
        }

definitions.name: SQLiteSimulationJobRepository._stage_final_confirmation
definitions.source:
def _stage_final_confirmation(self, view: LockedLeaseView, proposal: LeaseProposal) -> dict[str, Any]:
        if sys._getframe(1).f_code is not self._dispatch_writer.__code__:
            raise OperationalLeaseError("actual finalizer dispatch stages terminal confirmation")
        if self._final_publication_mode(view) != "LOCAL_TEMPORAL_PUBLICATION_V1":
            raise OperationalLeaseError("local pending audit requires local mode")
        context = getattr(self._transactions, "final_publication", None)
        target = dict(proposal.target)
        if context is None or view.purpose != "finalize_operational_publication" or target["lifecycle"] != "TERMINAL":
            raise OperationalLeaseError("exact final publication sources required")
        job = self.get_job(target["job_id"])
        payload = {**context, "target": target, "run_id": job.run_id,
                   "attempt": job.attempt, "epoch": target["epoch"],
                   "generation": target["generation"], "proof": None}
        row = {"run_id": job.run_id, "job_id": job.job_id, "attempt": job.attempt,
               "epoch": target["epoch"], "operation_id": _digest(["terminal-publication", job.run_id, job.attempt, target["epoch"]]),
               "generation": target["generation"], "state": "PENDING",
               "job_receipt_hash": _canonical(target),
               "event_receipt_hash": _digest(context["event_receipts"]),
               "artifact_manifest_sha256": _digest(context["manifest"]),
               "payload_json": json.dumps(payload, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), allow_nan=False),
               "confirmation_hash": ""}
        columns = tuple(row)
        view._connection.execute("INSERT INTO simulation_publication_confirmations_v1 (" + ",".join(columns)
            + ") VALUES (" + ",".join("?" for _ in columns) + ")", tuple(row[name] for name in columns))
        return row

definitions.name: SQLiteSimulationJobRepository._record_final_confirmation
definitions.source:
def _record_final_confirmation(self, view: LockedLeaseView, proof: _ConsumedFinalConfirmation,
                                   pending: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
        """Audit only; this path cannot renew a lease or modify historical outcomes."""
        from cloud_edge_robot_arm.vision.operational_windows import _OWNERS

        if (sys._getframe(1).f_code is not self._dispatch_writer.__code__
                or type(proof) is not _ConsumedFinalConfirmation or proof.session.repository is not self
                or proof.reply.view.view is not view or proof.pid != os.getpid()
                or proof.thread_id != threading.get_ident() or proof.native_thread_id != threading.get_native_id()):
            raise OperationalLeaseError("private consumed one-use final confirmation proof required")
        if self._final_publication_mode(view) != "LOCAL_TEMPORAL_PUBLICATION_V1":
            raise OperationalLeaseError("local consumed audit requires local mode")
        owner = _OWNERS.get(proof.session.worker)
        if owner is None:
            raise OperationalLeaseError("final confirmation lost original app owner")
        owner._check_app_live()
        payload = json.loads(pending["payload_json"])
        target = dict(proof.reply.proposal.proposal.target)
        if (payload["target"] != target or pending["job_receipt_hash"] != _canonical(target)
                or self._operational_row(view._connection, pending["job_id"]) != target
                or self._job_snapshot(view._connection, pending["job_id"]) != target["job_snapshot_json"]
                or self._publication_manifest(self._artifact_root, self.get_artifacts(pending["run_id"])) != payload["manifest"]):
            raise OperationalLeaseError("final proof/real commit/manifest join changed")
        payload["proof"] = {"commit_identity": proof.ack._commit_identity,
                            "committed_row_digest": proof.ack._row_digest,
                            "response_consumed": True, "generation": proof.observation.generation,
                            "epoch": proof.session.epoch, "pid": proof.pid,
                            "thread_id": proof.thread_id, "native_thread_id": proof.native_thread_id,
                            "app_current": {"domain": owner._local_original["app_domain"],
                                            "remaining_seconds": owner._remaining_app_seconds()},
                            "scope": "ARCHIVAL_CONFIRMATION_ONLY_NO_LIVE_AUTHORITY"}
        raw = json.dumps(payload, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), allow_nan=False)
        conn = view._connection
        conn.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
        row = conn.execute("SELECT * FROM simulation_publication_confirmations_v1 WHERE operation_id=?",
                           (pending["operation_id"],)).fetchone()
        if row is None or dict(row) != pending:
            raise OperationalLeaseError("final confirmation pending receipt changed")
        owner._check_app_live()
        cursor = conn.execute("UPDATE simulation_publication_confirmations_v1 SET state='CONFIRMED',payload_json=?,confirmation_hash=? "
            "WHERE operation_id=? AND state='PENDING' AND payload_json=?",
            (raw, _digest(payload), pending["operation_id"], pending["payload_json"]))
        if cursor.rowcount != 1:
            raise OperationalLeaseError("one-use final confirmation audit CAS0")
        conn.execute("COMMIT")

SQLiteSimulationJobRepository.publication_guard
definitions.source:
def publication_guard(self) -> Iterator[None]:
        """Brief cross-process exclusion for ownership changes and final evidence.

        Same-thread nested calls across repository instances share one flock;
        other threads serialize before opening their own descriptor. PID keys
        prevent a forked child from inheriting a false reentrant ownership claim.
        """
        key = (os.getpid(), str(self.database_path.resolve()))
        with _PUBLICATION_REGISTRY_LOCK:
            lock = _PUBLICATION_LOCKS.setdefault(key, RLock())
        with lock:
            held = getattr(_PUBLICATION_LOCAL, "held", None)
            if held is None:
                held = set()
                _PUBLICATION_LOCAL.held = held
            if key in held:
                yield
                return
            lock_path = self.database_path.with_name(self.database_path.name + ".publication.lock")
            with lock_path.open("a+b") as handle:
                fcntl.flock(handle.fileno(), fcntl.LOCK_EX)
                held.add(key)
                try:
                    yield
                finally:
                    held.remove(key)
                    fcntl.flock(handle.fileno(), fcntl.LOCK_UN)

definitions.name: SQLiteSimulationJobRepository._operational_transaction
definitions.source:
def _operational_transaction(
        self,
        session: OperationalLeaseSession,
        *,
        job_id: str | None,
        purpose: str,
        operation_sha256: str,
    ) -> Iterator[LockedLeaseView]:
        session._check_ingress(purpose)
        if session.repository is not self or job_id != session.job_id:
            raise OperationalLeaseError("session requires exact concrete repository/job")
        with self.publication_guard():
            self._initialize()
            if getattr(self._transactions, "connection", None) is not None:
                raise OperationalLeaseError("cannot issue nested/reused operational transaction")
            with self._connect() as conn:
                conn.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
                nonce = uuid4().hex
                owner = self._register_writer(conn, nonce, str(job_id), purpose)
                view: LockedLeaseView | None = None
                try:
                    row = self._operational_row(conn, str(job_id))
                    if row is None:
                        raise OperationalLeaseError("missing actual operational row")
                    self._validate_operational_row(conn, session, row)
                    view = _issue_view(session, self, conn, nonce, row, purpose, operation_sha256)
                    yield view
                except BaseException:
                    if view is not None:
                        _invalidate_view(view, "operational transaction exception")
                    raise
                finally:
                    self._finish_writer(owner, view)

definitions.name: SQLiteSimulationJobRepository._dispatch_writer
SQLiteSimulationJobRepository._connect
definitions.source:
def _connect(self) -> Iterator[sqlite3.Connection]:
        active = getattr(self._transactions, "connection", None)
        if active is not None:
            self._writer_binding()
            yield active
            return
        conn = sqlite3.connect(self.database_path, isolation_level=None, check_same_thread=False)
        conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
        conn.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON")
        conn.execute("PRAGMA journal_mode = WAL")
        try:
            yield conn
        except BaseException:
            try:
                conn.rollback()
            except sqlite3.Error:
                pass  # Preserve the original fault when the same real connection closed.
            raise
        finally:
            # sqlite3.Connection 的 context manager 不会关闭连接；repository 方法必须
            # 主动 close，避免长 validation 运行后堆积大量 DB/WAL/SHM fd。
            conn.close()

definitions.name: _take_final_confirmation
definitions.source:
def _take_final_confirmation(session: OperationalLeaseSession, ack: LeaseCommitAck) -> _ConsumedFinalConfirmation:
    """One-use proof only for the concrete repository's actual finalizer dispatch."""
    from cloud_edge_robot_arm.simulation_runtime.sqlite_repository import SQLiteSimulationJobRepository

    if (sys._getframe(1).f_code is not SQLiteSimulationJobRepository._dispatch_writer.__code__
            or type(session.repository) is not SQLiteSimulationJobRepository
            or _current_session(session.repository) is not session):
        raise OperationalLeaseError("private finalizer alone consumes a confirmation proof")
    session._check_ingress("finalize_operational_publication")
    if session._mode != "LOCAL_TEMPORAL_PUBLICATION_V1":
        raise OperationalLeaseError("local final confirmation proof requires local mode")
    issued = _ack_record(ack)
    with _REGISTRY_LOCK:
        proof = _CONSUMED_FINAL_CONFIRMATIONS.pop(id(ack), None)
    if (proof is None or proof.session is not session or proof.ack is not ack
            or proof.pid != os.getpid() or proof.thread_id != threading.get_ident()
            or proof.native_thread_id != threading.get_native_id()
            or issued.proposal is not proof.reply.proposal.proposal
            or proof.reply.view.view.purpose != "finalize_operational_publication"
            or proof.observation.status != "VALID" or not _ACK_USES.get(id(ack))):
        raise OperationalLeaseError("missing, copied or replayed consumed final confirmation")
    return proof

definitions.name: OperationalWindowOwner._check_app_live
OperationalWindowOwner._check_local_locked
definitions.source:
def _check_local_locked(self, view, *, purpose: str, operation_sha256: str):
        from cloud_edge_robot_arm.simulation_runtime.operational_lease import LockedLeaseView, _view_record
        from cloud_edge_robot_arm.vision.local_temporal import LocalAuthorityDecision

        self._check_app_live()
        s = self._startup
        if type(view) is not LockedLeaseView:
            raise OperationalTimeError("private genuine locked view required")
        issued = _view_record(view)
        session = s.worker._operational_lease_session
        if (issued.session is not session or issued.repository is not s.repository
                or view.purpose != purpose or view.operation_sha256 != operation_sha256):
            raise OperationalTimeError("private local view/source operation mismatch")
        observed = session.evaluate_locked(view)
        if observed.status != "VALID" or observed.attempt != s.attempt:
            raise OperationalTimeError("current broker lease authority invalid")
        frozen = _LOCAL_ORIGINALS.get(self)
        if frozen is None or _json(self._local_original) != frozen:
            raise OperationalTimeError("registered immutable local original source changed")
        original = json.loads(frozen)
        if (dict(observed.original_acquisition) != original["lease_identity"]["original_acquisition"]
                or observed.source_identity != self._source_identity):
            raise OperationalTimeError("original broker acquisition/source changed")
        self._check_app_live()
        current = self._clock.read_current(after=self.task_origin_token)
        row = dict(view.snapshot)
        return LocalAuthorityDecision.from_payload(_descriptor_plain({
            "schema_version": "visual.local-two-authority-decision.v1",
            "operation_id": purpose, "operation_sha256": operation_sha256,
            "original_time_hash": _hash(original), "app_domain": asdict(self._clock.domain),
            "app_current": {"domain": asdict(current.domain), "lower_ns": current.lower_ns,
                            "upper_ns": current.upper_ns, "event_identity": self.task_origin_token.event_identity},
            "app_verdict": {"status": "VALID", "reasons": []},
            "app_references": [self.export_record(self.task_window)],
            "lease_observation": _descriptor_plain({**observed.__dict__, "domain": asdict(observed.domain)}),
            "lease_epoch": session.epoch, "lease_generation": row["generation"],
            "lease_row_revision": row["row_revision"], "lease_row_digest": row["proposed_row_digest"],
            "source_identity": observed.source_identity, "job_id": s.job_id, "run_id": s.run_id,
            "worker_id": s.worker.worker_id, "lease_id": s.lease_id, "attempt": s.attempt,
            "disposition": "VALID", "reasons": [],
        }))

VisualWorkerRuntime._local_commit
definitions.source:
def _local_commit(self, scope, updates, transaction, *, _resume=None):
        """Four actual commits; every durable stage remains nonauthorizing alone."""
        from cloud_edge_robot_arm.repositories.event_autonomy.protocol import (
            local_put_unlocked, local_receipt_unlocked, local_receipt_read_unlocked,
        )
        from cloud_edge_robot_arm.vision.local_temporal import _canonical, _copy, _hash, LocalEnvelope

        events, repo, conn = self.source.event_repository, self.source.job_repository, scope.view._connection
        if _local_scope_for(events, required=True) is not scope:
            raise RuntimeError("original private coordinator unavailable")
        self._operational_owner._check_local_locked(scope.view, purpose=scope.operation_id,
                                                    operation_sha256=scope.operation_sha256)
        base = {"operation_id": scope.operation_id, "operation_sha256": scope.operation_sha256,
                "job_id": self.source.job_id, "attempt": transaction["attempt"],
                "lease_id": transaction["lease_id"], "epoch": transaction["epoch"],
                "generation": transaction["generation"], "row_revision": transaction["row_revision"],
                "event_record_hash": transaction["event_record_hash"]}
        pending_hash = _hash({**base, "phase": "PENDING"})
        job_hash = _hash({**base, "phase": "EVENT_COMMITTED", "event_receipt_hash": pending_hash})
        complete_hash = _hash({**base, "phase": "COMPLETE", "job_receipt_hash": job_hash,
                               "pending_receipt_hash": pending_hash})

        def complete(value):
            if isinstance(value, list):
                return [complete(item) for item in value]
            if not isinstance(value, dict):
                return value
            result = {key: complete(item) for key, item in value.items()}
            if (result.get("schema_version") == "visual.local-publication-transaction.v1"
                    and result.get("operation_id") == scope.operation_id):
                result.update(phase="COMPLETE", job_receipt_hash=job_hash, event_receipt_hash=complete_hash)
            return result

        final_updates = complete(_copy(updates))
        for entry in final_updates.values():
            value = entry["value"]
            if isinstance(value, dict) and str(value.get("schema_version", "")).endswith(".local.v1"):
                LocalEnvelope.from_payload(value)
        payload = _canonical({"pending_updates": _copy(updates), "complete_updates": final_updates})
        receipt = {**base, "phase": "PENDING", "event_receipt_hash": pending_hash,
                   "job_receipt_hash": "", "payload_json": payload}
        if _resume is None:
            for category, entry in updates.items():
                local_put_unlocked(events, category, entry["key"], entry["value"], self._local_task_id)
            local_receipt_unlocked(events, receipt)  # event semantic/debit and PENDING really commit first
        else:
            if (local_receipt_read_unlocked(events, scope.operation_id) != _resume
                    or any(_resume[field] != value for field, value in base.items())
                    or _resume["payload_json"] != payload
                    or _resume["phase"] not in {"PENDING", "EVENT_COMMITTED", "COMPLETE"}):
                raise RuntimeError("exact pending source changed under private reconciliation")
            # The prior semantic writes/debit are already durable. End only the
            # fresh read transaction; do not repeat, refund or replay any effect.
            if type(events) is SQLiteEventAutonomyRepository:
                events._conn.execute("ROLLBACK")
        receipt.update(phase="EVENT_COMMITTED", job_receipt_hash=job_hash)
        repo._local_publication_receipt(scope.view, receipt)  # actual first job commit
        conn.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
        actual = repo._operational_row(conn, self.source.job_id)
        if actual != dict(scope.view.snapshot):
            raise RuntimeError("current private job generation changed after receipt commit")
        self._operational_owner._check_local_locked(scope.view, purpose=scope.operation_id,
                                                    operation_sha256=scope.operation_sha256)
        if type(events) is SQLiteEventAutonomyRepository:
            events._conn.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
        for category, entry in final_updates.items():
            local_put_unlocked(events, category, entry["key"], entry["value"], self._local_task_id)
        receipt.update(phase="COMPLETE", event_receipt_hash=complete_hash)
        local_receipt_unlocked(events, receipt)  # actual event completion commit
        repo._local_publication_receipt(scope.view, receipt)  # actual job completion commit
        conn.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
        return final_updates
